title: Editing a tag group: menu actions, filled-in window, hover and success
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Notifications page opens from the bell icon at the top right, next to your location name.
  2. Open the Notifications page from the bell and select the Tag groups tab. An active location is selected (the location name shown next to the bell; change it with your initials at the top right -> Change Location).
  3. Seed a tag group: on the Tag groups tab click New tag group, type a Name (e.g. "Service Team"), pick at least one Member (e.g. "Ashlee Thomas"), leave Public off (or turn it on for a public group), and Create.
custom_steps:
1. On a group you own (and a public group as an admin), read the Edit and Delete actions on its row.
  2. Hover a row.
  3. Open Edit and read the dialog title and prefilled fields; save and read the success message.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The owner of a group, or any admin when the group is public, sees Edit and Delete actions on its row; hovering a row shows every member's name.
  • Edit opens the same dialog titled "Edit tag group", filled in with the group's name, members and visibility; saving confirms with "Tag group updated".

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10249 (S6, Manage tag groups); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S6; design boards TagGroups/Modal; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.
